$comment: Every entry needs a `reason`, because an unexplained exemption is how an
allowlist rots. An entry that stops matching anything is reported as a stale
exemption so it gets deleted instead of accumulating.
`files`     — whole files the audit skips (generated/vendored content only).
`allow`     — one entry per finding that is correct as written. `match` is a
substring of the reported token or message; `file` (optional)
narrows it to a path glob.
`envAllow`  — env names supplied by the platform rather than the repository.
`bannedPhrases` — phrases that describe behaviour the app no longer has.
`except` names the files allowed to use the phrase because they
are explicitly narrating its removal, or predate it as history.

bannedPhrases.reason: there is no poll loop to fall back to — catch-up happens on reconnect, on tab return, and via the sidebar refetch when a user is over the live-socket cap
same: realtime degradation is reconnect-based, not poll-based
there is no server-side image processing — the browser compresses before upload and the server validates the signature
both clients run on Cloudflare Durable Objects; the phrase is allowed only where a file is explicitly narrating the retired publication or is a historical migration

allow.reason: names the `Schema` type parameter of SupabaseClient — an external type, not a repository symbol
same: the Supabase client's `Schema` generic, which is what the generated database types fill in
the comment names the legacy option that was removed (a body-size middleware it warns against re-adding), so the name is deliberately gone from the code
a Turbopack directive recognised by the bundler, not an identifier in this codebase
Expo MediaLibrary's API, named to explain why `saveToLibraryAsync` was chosen instead
historical migration describing the retired Supabase Realtime publication
written by k6/scripts/seed-users.js into a gitignored directory, so it exists only while a load test is running
the 'before' columns of this document name the files the refactor deleted — that is the point of the table
the header states the migration away from Supabase Realtime; the phrase is the contrast, not a claim
